name: casefile
description: Casefile - adaptive web app auditor (Next.js frontend + Express/Playwright/Gemini backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "cd backend && ./venv/bin/uvicorn src.main:app --port 4001 --reload" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && ./venv/bin/playwright install chromium && cd .. && npm install --prefix frontend
